claims.statement: Timesheet validation lives in backend/internal/domain/services/timesheet_validation_*.go and is composed of single-responsibility validators (status, assignment, day type, daily hours, zero rate) returning typed Vietnamese domain errors; TimesheetValidationService composes the chain with a per-request validationContext cache to avoid duplicate lookups.

The BCC import pipeline is decomposed across bcc_import_*.go files: shared fail/empty/finalize helpers in bcc_import_pipeline.go, lifecycle (asset persistence, audit emission) in bcc_import_lifecycle.go, per-row processor with validation in bcc_import_process.go, format-specific files for weekly/multi-position/weekly-payment/STK variants, rate normalization in bcc_import_weekly_rates.go, and a per-(project, for_month) concurrency lock in bcc_import_lock.go.

Editing an approved timesheet is rejected by the validator; corrections must go through a reversal/offset flow that creates a paired negative entry rather than mutating the original, preserving the audit trail of the approved value.

Live-API integration tests cover the BCC pipeline end-to-end through HTTP: flow_bcc_import.go, flow_bcc_weekly_import.go, flow_bcc_weekly_payment_import.go assert row counts, audit emission, and idempotency on re-upload, while flow_timesheet_extended.go and flow_partner_timesheet.go exercise validation chains and role-scoped reads.
